publicPrimaryAPI.publicCongruenceDeclaration:
theorem memLp_congr_ae {f g : α → ε} (hfg : f =ᵐ[μ] g) :
    MemLp f p μ ↔ MemLp g p μ := by
  refine ⟨fun hf ↦ ?_, fun hg ↦ ?_⟩
  · rwa [memLp_iff, ← eLpNorm_congr_ae hfg]
  · rwa [memLp_iff, eLpNorm_congr_ae hfg]

theorem MemLp.ae_eq {f g : α → ε} (hfg : f =ᵐ[μ] g) (hf_Lp : MemLp f p μ) :
    MemLp g p μ :=
  (memLp_congr_ae hfg).1 hf_Lp
publicPrimaryAPI.mpOrientation: For hfg:f=ae g, (memLp_congr_ae hfg).mp takes MemLp f to MemLp g. The new hDeletedAE is scaled numerator =ae Ddel, so the direction is exact.

literalDefinitionalConversion.text:
def residualStatisticD
    (n : ℕ) {Ω : Type u}
    (r : Ω → Ω → ℝ) (x : Fin n → Ω) : ℝ :=
  originalUpper n r x / (Real.sqrt (n : ℝ) * ((n : ℝ) - 1))

def originalUpper (n : ℕ) {Ω : Type*} (r : Ω → Ω → ℝ) (x : Fin n → Ω) : ℝ :=
  ∑ i : Fin n, ∑ j : Fin n, if i < j then r (x i) (x j) else 0
